requirements.statement: ARM Addressing Mode 2 forms an immediate or immediate-shifted register offset, adds or subtracts it from Rn, uses the adjusted address for pre-indexing and Rn itself for post-indexing, and computes the specified writeback address.
P selects pre/post indexing, U selects add/subtract, B selects byte/word, L selects load/store, post-index always writes back, and P=0/W=1 marks the translated user-privilege access variants.

For these pre-ARMv6 profiles, register-offset Rm cannot be R15; a writeback form cannot use R15 as Rn, use the same Rn and Rm for a register offset, or use the same Rd and Rn; byte transfers cannot use R15 as Rd.
